title: Xi Pursues AI Governance Leadership at Beijing Summit
notes: Named-author think-tank analysis; factual claims attributed to Xinhua, MFA, NDRC, People's Daily; strategic interpretation is the authors'. Cited for WAICO unveiling and the Global South capacity-building pledges under Social. Issues: Title says 'Beijing Summit' but the event is WAIC in Shanghai.
claims: WAICO (World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization) unveiled at WAIC 2026, headquartered in Shanghai, billed as first intergovernmental body dedicated to AI
Xi pledged 5,000 AI research and training opportunities via centers in ASEAN, Arab League, AU, SCO, Latin America, BRICS
China offered the Mazu meteorological AI system to 30 countries
NDRC released an eight-point AI Action Plan on July 17, 2026
Cambodia, Thailand, and Kazakhstan endorsed Beijing's AI regulatory approach after the conference
2026 domestic regulations include Interim Measures on AI Anthropomorphic Interactive Services (CAC, April 10, 2026)
